schemaHelp.title: Zero-Code Declarative UI for External Mods
schemaHelp.p1: External mods (including legacy TesmioLoader, RML v1, or raw DLLs without GRML C++ integration) can ship a tiny <ModName>.ui.yaml or <ModName>.ui.json beside their DLL, or include a "settingsUi" block in <ModName>.grml.json.
schemaHelp.p2: GRML automatically renders those controls both here in the Launcher and in-game inside the mod menu (press {hotkey}), reading & saving directly to the mod's .ini file.

settings.title: Loader Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes are saved automatically to grml.ini in %LOCALAPPDATA%\GRML.
settings.languageTip: Select the display language for the launcher UI and mod settings. Custom translations can be placed in a locales\ folder.
settings.gameExeTip: Path to your SOVIET64.exe installation used for launching, version detection, and Workshop discovery.
settings.scanWorkshopTip: Automatically discover DLL plugins inside subscribed Steam Workshop mod folders (enabled by default).
settings.scanWipTip: Discover local in-development DLL mods inside media_soviet\workshop_wip\ (enabled by default).
settings.vfsTip: Non-destructive virtual filesystem redirection for media_soviet\ and override\ packs (saved to grml_vfs.ini).
settings.hotkeyTip: Key used in-game to toggle the GRML Mod Settings overlay (saved as overlay_hotkey in grml.ini; takes effect on next game launch).
settings.menuTagLabel: Show GRML Tag on Main Menu
settings.menuTagTip: Appends | GRML 2.0.0 to the in-game main menu version string so you can confirm GRML is active.
settings.skipIntroTip: Automatically advances past the 9.5s 3Division / Hooded Horse intro logo timer while Workshop items and assets load in the background (skip_intro_logos in grml.ini).
settings.offsetsTip: Downloads the latest config/grml_offsets.ini from GitHub and invalidates the PE-hash RVA cache.
settings.updatesTip: Checks ZydraHydra/GloriousRepublicModLoader releases on GitHub against your installed version.
settings.devModeTip: Redirect savegames, Steam Workshop (784150), workshop_wip, and media_overrides to shared folders regardless of which SOVIET64.exe copy is launched (dev_mode in grml.ini).
settings.devPathPlaceholder: Leave empty to use default game path
settings.autoBackupTip: Automatically copies your entire media_soviet\save folder into a timestamped backup folder before launching WRSR (auto_backup_saves in grml.ini).
settings.maxBackupsTip: Oldest save_backup_* folders are automatically removed once this limit is exceeded (max_save_backups in grml.ini, default 3).
settings.backupPathTip: Destination folder for timestamped savegame backups (save_backup_path in grml.ini). Leave empty to use %LOCALAPPDATA%\GRML\save_backups.
